title: CSC674_Project: Loan Approval Prediction with Fairness Analysis
summary: A course project for CSC674 Machine Learning that builds a loan-approval classifier with fairness/bias analysis across gender groups. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with Metadata to generate up to 30,000 synthetic loan records, and runs SDV's run_diagnostic to validate the synthetic data.
